column1: # GW2Chatlator - built-in GW2 terms. One line per term: term <TAB> kind <TAB> meaning (the file uses tabs).
# kind keep - never translated, in any spelling ("LFG", "lfg"); several words are one term ("Wizard's Vault")
# kind caps - never translated when written like an abbreviation (two capitals or more): "AB" Auric Basin, German "ab" stays a word
# kind word - a GW2 word that is translated like any word, only never marked as a spelling error
# The meaning is a short note for whoever keeps this list. After a change: python tools/gen_terms.py (core_tests checks it).
